title: Kate and the Raindrop Roads
synopsis: Kate watches two drops travel down the outside of a window, join other drops, and make changing little roads in the rain.

related_resources.reason: Kate makes and revises an informal prediction while observing rain on glass; this is an editorial parallel to noticing changes.
The short repeated rain sounds and easy-to-follow window scene allow optional participation in shared reading.
